_doc: Narrative spine: your first year teaching 5th grade at Maple Ridge School. One chapter per mission, ordered by the school calendar. Speakers: vee (Coach Vera Okonkwo), hollis (Mr. Hollis), reyes (Principal Reyes), you (inner voice, italic), narrator (caption), or a persona id from data/persona_library. 'mood' picks a portrait suffix when it exists. intro plays before the mission; outro_win / outro_retry play as Coach Vee's line on the debrief.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Maple Ridge School. 7:52 a.m. Your name is on the door for the first time.

intro.speaker: you
intro.text: Eight students. One lesson on fractions. I rehearsed this in the car three times.

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: I'm Vera Okonkwo. Everyone calls me Coach Vee. I won't grade you today. I'll watch what you do.

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: A calm lecture feels like it's working. Then you look up and half the room is gone.

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: Talk for a bit, then stop and check. If you only talk, you won't know who's still with you.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The bell rings.

outro_win.speaker: vee
outro_win.text: You stopped talking to find out what they knew. Most people take a whole semester to learn that.

outro_retry.speaker: vee
outro_retry.text: You taught the whole lesson. Did they learn it? Next time, check before you move on.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Practice day. Worksheets out. The room goes quiet.

intro.speaker: you
intro.text: Quiet means it's going well. Right?

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: Quiet doesn't mean working. {riley_avoidant} hasn't written a word. {marcus_volatile} is one eraser away from a meltdown.
intro.fallback: Quiet doesn't mean working. Somebody hasn't written a word. Somebody else is one eraser away from a meltdown.

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: Get out from behind the desk. Walk the rows, and sit down with each of them.

intro.speaker: riley_avoidant
intro.text: ...I'm fine. I'm just thinking.

outro_win.speaker: vee
outro_win.text: You found the kids who were stuck and not saying so. Standing close did more than a warning would.

outro_retry.speaker: vee
outro_retry.text: The rows looked calm. The worksheets didn't. Next time, keep moving and look at what they're writing.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: You pushed the desks into a U. Now everyone can see everyone.

intro.speaker: talia_dominator
intro.text: Oh! Me! I know it! Can I go first? I always go first.

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: {talia_dominator} will fill every silence you leave. {sam_withdrawn} won't fill any of them.
intro.fallback: Some of them will fill every silence you leave. Some won't fill any of them.

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: Count three seconds before you call on anyone, and pick on purpose. Your quiet ones need the time.

intro.speaker: you
intro.text: Three seconds. It's going to feel like forever.

outro_win.speaker: vee
outro_win.text: You waited long enough for the quiet ideas to come out. Did you see {sam_withdrawn}'s face?
outro_win.fallback: You waited long enough for the quiet ideas to come out. Did you see their faces?

outro_retry.speaker: vee
outro_retry.text: {talia_dominator} steered the whole thing today. Wait longer, and you decide who talks.
outro_retry.fallback: One loud voice steered the whole thing today. Wait longer, and you decide who talks.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Reading block. A short article about honeybees, and six different ideas about what it's really about.

intro.speaker: jordan_skeptic
intro.text: It's about bees. Like, obviously. Can we be done?

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: {jordan_skeptic}'s got a detail. He hasn't got the point yet. Start there.
intro.fallback: They've got a detail. Not the point yet. Start there.

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: Don't hand them the main idea. Ask how they got theirs, then build on it.

outro_win.speaker: vee
outro_win.text: They got to the main idea on their own. You just kept asking.

outro_retry.speaker: vee
outro_retry.text: You told them the main idea. Next time, ask them how they got theirs first.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Parent conferences were last night. You learned more in two hours than in two months.

intro.speaker: you
intro.text: {diego_ell} helps run his aunt's food truck. {jordan_skeptic} fixes bikes. I didn't know any of it.
intro.fallback: One of them helps run a family food truck. One fixes bikes. I didn't know any of it.

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: Every kid walks in knowing stuff. Find where the lesson hooks into it.

intro.speaker: diego_ell
intro.text: At the truck, I cut the pizza in eight. Is that... fractions?

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: Find out what they know before you correct anything.

outro_win.speaker: vee
outro_win.text: You taught fractions with a food truck and a bike chain. They'll remember that one.

outro_retry.speaker: vee
outro_retry.text: You went straight to correcting. Next time, start with what each of them already knows.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Snow outside. Decimals inside. Nobody is thrilled.

intro.speaker: noah_g5_fractions
intro.text: 0.25 is bigger than 0.5, because 25 is bigger than 5. ...Isn't it?

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: He's not being careless. He has a theory, and it makes sense to him. Find out why before you fix it.

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: Get an idea out of everyone. You'll learn the most from the wrong ones.

outro_win.speaker: vee
outro_win.text: You let a wrong idea come out in public and the class took it apart. That's hard to do.

outro_retry.speaker: vee
outro_retry.text: You fixed the answer, but the wrong idea is still there. Ask about it next time.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Back from break. Clusters, fraction strips, and the kind of noise that could go either way.

intro.speaker: hollis
intro.text: Twenty-eight years, kid. Group work is just recess with worksheets. I stopped doing it in '09.

intro.speaker: you
intro.text: Is that where I end up? Tired and certain?

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: Years alone don't make you better. Practicing does, and Hollis quit a long time ago.

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: Visit every group. Make sure every kid gets a real turn to talk.

outro_win.speaker: vee
outro_win.text: You got to every group and everybody talked. Hollis was watching from the door, by the way.

outro_retry.speaker: vee
outro_retry.text: One group took over and another drifted. Visit all of them, and keep turns even.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Ramps. Carts. A box of weights. And a very confident misconception.

intro.speaker: hollis
intro.text: Mind if I watch? ...I used to love this unit.

intro.speaker: marcus_volatile
intro.text: Heavy stuff goes faster. Everybody knows that. This is dumb.

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: Don't argue with {marcus_volatile}. Let the cart show him. Just get them looking at the results together.
intro.fallback: Don't argue with the angry one. Let the cart show him. Just get them looking at the results together.

outro_win.speaker: vee
outro_win.text: Their own results changed their minds. Hollis asked to borrow your ramps.

outro_retry.speaker: vee
outro_retry.text: They ran the experiment but kept their old ideas. Get them talking about the results together.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Formal observation. Principal Reyes, a clipboard, and forty-two minutes.

intro.speaker: reyes
intro.text: Pretend I'm not here. I'm only writing down what I see.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Eleven minutes in, the projector dies. {marcus_volatile}'s chair hits the floor. {noah_g5_fractions}'s hand is up. {priya_quiet} is crying quietly.
intro.fallback: Eleven minutes in, the projector dies. A chair hits the floor. A hand is up. Someone is crying quietly.

intro.speaker: you
intro.text: Nobody rehearses this part.

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: You've been rehearsing this all year. One student at a time.

intro.speaker: vee
intro.text: Breathe. Then pick one.

outro_win.speaker: reyes
outro_win.text: I've watched a lot of first-years. Most freeze. You picked who to help first, and you were right.

outro_retry.speaker: vee
outro_retry.text: It went sideways. That's the job some days. Let's look at the first thirty seconds again.
